name: cover

frames.best_why: Faint blue beam lines cross the boxed words, showing the travelling-light effect mid-sweep.

tagline: Boxed words light up with racing beams and a warp-speed shake.
summary: Inline text wrapped in a dark box with corner dots; hovering makes horizontal light beams race across it, a starfield stream past and the words shudder as if jumping to warp.
appearance: A two-line white headline on black, with the final two words enclosed in a dark rectangle. Four small dim dots mark the box corners, and thin horizontal lines and a scatter of white specks appear across the words when active.
behaviour: Hovering the box sends white beams sweeping sideways across it and streams a white starfield behind the words while the phrase shakes and shrinks slightly. Leaving stops the motion and restores the flat box.
demo_content: Headline: Ship production sites at warp speed.
use_when: A headline needs one keyword to feel like a sci-fi interaction without leaving the text line.
avoid_when: Touch or motion-sensitive users: it triggers only on hover and runs a hard shake while held.
customise: The wrapped words arrive as children with an optional class name; the box, corner dots, beams and particle field behind them are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Hundreds of particles plus several SVG beams run only while the phrase is hovered.

a11y.note: The effect is hover-only and checks no reduced-motion preference, so keyboard and motion-sensitive users get none of it.

issues: At rest the box is so understated that the effect is invisible until someone hovers.
polish_why: Crisp headline and a convincing warp moment; the resting box is understated and hover-only.
